= Sanovic =

'''Sanovic''' ({{lang|san|Сановик}}), also known as '''Union Zhensanovian''', is the constructed lingua franca of the [[Union of Zhensanov]]. Designed to unify the diverse peoples of the Union, Sanovic combines elements from all major Zhensanovian language families while maintaining its own distinct structure.{{Infobox language

== Overview ==

Sanovic was created in the early 21st century as a neutral lingua franca for the Union of Zhensanov. Unlike natural languages, it was deliberately designed to incorporate elements from all major Zhensanovian language families while avoiding favoritism toward any particular ethnic group. The language is used in government, education, and inter-ethnic communication throughout the Union.

| -o

| O house!

=== Verbs ===
Sanovic verbs can conjugate in two ways:

1. '''Suffix-based conjugation''' (Murianic style):
   * Present: -∅ (govor = speak)
   * Past: -l (govoril = spoke)
   * Future: -t (govorit = will speak)

2. '''Particle-based conjugation''' (Kavetsian style):
   * Present: ∅ govor
   * Past: bil govor
   * Future: bud govor

=== Word Order ===
Sanovic has flexible word order due to its case system, though the default is Subject-Verb-Object (SVO).

== Writing System ==

Sanovic uses the [[Union Alphabet]], a specially designed script that can represent all sounds in Zhensanovian languages. The alphabet consists of 45 base letters and various diacritics.

=== Sample Text ===
{{lang|san|'''Сановик ест язык единства народа Зенсанова.'''}}
"Sanovic is the language of unity of the Zhensanovian people."

== Vocabulary ==

Sanovic vocabulary is drawn from all major Zhensanovian languages:

* From Murianic: vodan (water), zemla (earth)
* From Agashkinic: küne (sun), ölüm (life)
* From Tekdolian: tagor (mountain), tlum (forest)
* From Toramdic: naroda (people), mir (peace)
* From Kavetsian: zhizn (life), put (path)

== Usage ==

Sanovic is used in:
* Government proceedings
* National education
* Inter-ethnic communication
* Official documents
* Media broadcasts
* International diplomacy
